name: Witch's Broom
note: Halloween 2026 (lane Cues B, docs/prompts/HW_CUES_B_PROMPT.md 2.4, concept C3b_broom.png): a crooked bark branch with a violet crystal tip, a knot hole, twig stubs, a purple binding with a silver buckle and gold crescent, golden straw bristles and a swaying witch-hat charm; purple and emerald magic ribbons, stars, crescents, bats. Draft until the body, aura, trail, finisher and card are done (leaving draft hands the cue to the track's earners).
